ns0:svg.ns0:text: Technical Performance Margin Monitor — Evidence Boundary
Using only the first 60% of each history, the linear baseline is 5.5 cycles late for B0005, 10.1 cycles early
for B0006, and 0.2 cycles late for B0018. For B0007 it predicts a crossing near cycle 150 even though observed
capacity remains above 1.4 Ah through cycle 168, a false early threshold prediction.
This is a transparent prognostics baseline, not a validated production health-management model. The processed
CSV is a convenience derivative of the NASA source. B0007 demonstrates that a projected crossing inside the
observed horizon need not actually occur; projection is not observation.
